description: Recording upload: permission, meeting status, validation and storage.
precondition: Meeting with participants; file storage recorder.

preconditions: InPerson meeting in status InProgress.
The actor is its current Secretary and an active user.
The audio file is already stored by the endpoint at 'recordings/x.mp3'.
Retention is 180 days; the clock reads 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC.
cases.inputs: upload: file 'hop.mp3', audio/mpeg, 5,000,000 bytes, source Upload, consent confirmed, purpose '  Họp HĐQT  ', duration 3,600,000 ms.
cases.return: Success with the new recording id (201, MSG290): status Available, consent time 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC, purpose 'Họp HĐQT' (trimmed), RetainUntil 2027-05-13 10:00 UTC, maker = the Secretary, an empty transcript in status Pending is created for the worker.
cases.log: Audit RecordingUploaded (meeting, file name, size, source, purpose, retainUntil); RecordingsChanged published to the meeting; the stored file is kept.
